I found Bob’s body in weapons and reported immediately. My route this round was storage -> medbay -> electrical -> security -> weapons. The only person I saw on the way was Frank in medbay around ticks 3 to 5. I didn’t see Alice, Diana, or Eve at all, and I didn’t see anyone near weapons when I got there.

I started in weapons and saw Bob there very early — he came in from security while I was leaving, so he was alive at the start. After that I went security, then cafeteria, medbay, upper engine, oxygen, and back upper engine. I didn’t see anyone else for most of the round, which is kind of weird.

Charlie’s route ending at weapons makes sense with the report, but I can’t clear them since the body was exactly where they ended. I also didn’t see Alice or Diana at all, so I’d like to hear where they were. Frank being in medbay around ticks 3 to 5 lines up with Charlie seeing him there, so that gives Frank a little bit of credibility for that window.

My route was cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper engine -> lower engine. I didn’t see Bob at all, and I didn’t see Charlie, Eve, or Diana this round.

The only person I saw was Frank: I saw him enter upper engine from medbay around tick 7, then he came into lower engine from upper engine at tick 12. We were both in lower engine ticks 12 to 14, then he left toward storage at tick 15. That lines up pretty well with Charlie seeing Frank in medbay around ticks 3 to 5, so Frank’s path seems consistent at least from medbay onward.

I don’t think I can clear anyone for the weapons kill, but Frank feels less likely unless the kill was extremely early before medbay. I’d really like to hear Diana’s route, since I didn’t see her at all and we don’t have much info on her yet. Charlie reporting in weapons is also not a clear, but I don’t have a direct reason to accuse them yet.

My route was navigation -> security -> electrical -> medbay. I didn’t encounter anyone at all, and I never went into weapons, so I didn’t see Bob’s body or Bob alive.

From what we have, Frank’s route is the most cross-checked: Charlie saw him in medbay early, then Alice saw him upper/lower engine later. That makes Frank less suspicious to me unless this kill happened extremely early.

The main unclear points for me are Eve and Charlie. Eve says she was in weapons at the start and saw Bob alive there, so she may have been the last confirmed person near him. Charlie is the reporter and ended in weapons, so it could be a real report or a self-report, but I don’t have proof either way.

I’m not confident enough to hard accuse yet. I want to hear Frank’s full route before deciding, but right now I’m leaning skip unless Frank gives something that contradicts.

My route was electrical -> medbay -> upper engine -> lower engine.

I can confirm Charlie was in medbay with me ticks 3 to 5 — I saw Charlie enter medbay from storage at tick 3, then we overlapped there for a bit. Later I went up through upper engine and ended in lower engine, where I saw Alice around ticks 13 to 15. I also saw Alice moving from upper engine toward lower engine before that, so Alice’s account of being in upper/lower engine matches what I saw.

So from my side, Alice and Charlie both have pieces of their routes that line up with mine, and apparently my route lines up with both of theirs too. That doesn’t fully clear anyone, but it makes me less suspicious of Alice at least, since she was far from weapons late.

For the actual Bob kill in weapons, the two people with the most connection are still Eve and Charlie: Eve says she started weapons and saw Bob alive there, and Charlie found/reported the body there later. I don’t have enough to say which is more likely. Diana being unseen by everyone is also not great, but her route doesn’t directly place her in weapons.

I don’t think we have a solid vote here. I’m leaning skip unless someone has stronger timing, because a wrong vote is bad for us.

I found Diana’s body in cafeteria and reported immediately.

My route this round was: navigation -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper_engine -> oxygen -> cafeteria.

Earlier I saw Frank in medbay around ticks 3-5, but that was a long time before this body. The important part: I saw Diana at oxygen around tick 27. She came into oxygen from upper_engine, then at tick 28 she left oxygen toward cafeteria. I later went back to cafeteria and found her dead there.

I didn’t see the kill happen, and I didn’t see who was with her in cafeteria. But Diana was definitely alive in oxygen right before going to cafeteria, so whoever was around cafeteria shortly after that needs to explain.

My route was medbay -> storage -> navigation -> security -> navigation -> storage.

Early round I was with Charlie in medbay around ticks 3-5, so that’s long before Diana died and doesn’t really clear either of us for this kill. Later I saw Alice in storage at tick 21 — she came in from lower_engine — and then I saw Alice again in navigation at tick 29.

I never saw Diana this round, and I never saw Eve at all. Based on Charlie saying Diana left oxygen toward cafeteria at tick 28, Alice being in navigation at tick 29 makes her less likely for that specific cafeteria kill unless she moved insanely fast through there. I can’t fully clear her, but from my info she wasn’t near cafeteria at the key moment.

That means I really need to hear from Alice and Eve, especially Eve since I have no sightings of her. Charlie could technically be self-reporting, but his timeline is pretty specific.

My route was upper_engine -> lower_engine -> storage -> navigation -> security -> weapons.

I saw Frank in lower_engine around ticks 13-14, then later in storage at tick 21. I also saw Diana alive in lower_engine at tick 19 — she came in from storage. Frank left storage toward navigation at tick 22. Around the late part I was on the navigation/security/weapons side, not cafeteria.

So for Diana: I can confirm she was alive at tick 19 in lower_engine, and Charlie’s info has her alive much later in oxygen at 27, then leaving to cafeteria at 28. I was not near cafeteria then. Frank’s sightings and my own route make me think Frank is probably not the cafeteria killer either, unless there’s some route timing I’m missing.

I also never saw Eve at all this round, and Frank didn’t either. So I really need Eve’s route. Right now the main possibilities to me are either Eve was around cafeteria and unseen, or Charlie self-reported — but Charlie’s timeline is specific, so I want to hear Eve before deciding.

I get why you’re asking me — I was mostly alone, so here’s my route.

I started weapons, then went security -> electrical -> back through security -> navigation -> storage -> medbay -> cafeteria -> electrical. I didn’t cross Alice or Frank, which lines up with them being more on storage/nav/security side at different times.

Important part: I did pass through cafeteria late and saw Diana alive coming in from oxygen, around the time Charlie is talking about. I didn’t stay there — I was moving through toward electrical, and there was no body when I left. I didn’t see Charlie in cafeteria at that moment.

So from my POV, Diana was alive when she reached cafeteria, then Charlie later reports her there. That doesn’t hard-clear me because I was near there briefly, I know that, but Charlie is also the one with the very specific Diana timeline and he’s now reported both bodies this game. I’m not saying it’s definitely him, but I think Charlie self-report is very possible here.

Eve’s story actually puts her exactly at the kill window. Diana leaves oxygen to cafeteria at tick 28, Eve says she was in cafeteria and saw Diana arrive alive, then “kept moving,” and then I come back and find Diana dead there.

I get that I’m the reporter again, but reporting bodies is what I’m supposed to do — I didn’t hide it or delay. My route is consistent, and Diana being alive in oxygen at 27 then dead in cafeteria shortly after is the key timing.

Alice and Frank both seem to have routes placing them away from cafeteria late. Eve was unseen by multiple people all round and is the only one admitting she was in cafeteria with Diana at the exact relevant time. From my perspective, that’s the strongest evidence we have. I think this is Eve.

From my side, nothing changes on my route: I was medbay -> storage -> navigation -> security -> navigation -> storage. I only saw Charlie very early in medbay, and Alice later in storage/nav. I never saw Eve or Diana.

At this point I think Alice and I are pretty far from the Diana kill window. So it’s basically between Charlie self-reporting and Eve killing while passing through cafeteria.

Charlie reporting both bodies is definitely something to note, but Eve’s own story puts her in cafeteria with Diana alive right at the critical moment, and multiple people didn’t see Eve all round. That’s a lot more direct opportunity than just “Charlie reported.”

I’m leaning Eve here. If Eve is goose, then Charlie must have killed after she left, but right now Eve being last with Diana in cafeteria is the strongest evidence.

I’m still on the same read: my route kept me away from cafeteria late — upper_engine, lower_engine, storage, navigation, security, weapons. I saw Frank in lower_engine early and storage later, and I saw Diana alive in lower_engine at tick 19. After that, Charlie has Diana alive in oxygen at 27 and leaving toward cafeteria at 28.

So the actual kill window is really tight around cafeteria after Diana arrives there. Frank and I both have sightings/routes that put us away from that area. That leaves Charlie self-reporting or Eve killing while passing through.

I don’t want to ignore that Charlie reported both bodies, because self-report is possible. But Eve’s own story puts her in cafeteria with Diana alive at the exact critical moment, and nobody else saw Eve all round. That’s the strongest direct opportunity we have.

Unless Eve has some really specific timing that proves she left before Diana could’ve died, I’m voting Eve.

I need to push back hard here because you’re all treating me being honest about a late cafeteria pass as if it’s a confession.

I was not “with Diana” for a while. I passed through cafeteria, saw her come in from oxygen alive, and continued toward electrical. I didn’t see a body, I didn’t see Charlie, and I didn’t stop there. If I were trying to hide something, I could’ve just said I never went cafeteria because nobody saw me anyway — but I gave the actual route.

The thing that bothers me is Charlie has now reported both bodies, and for this one he’s the only person controlling the entire oxygen/cafeteria timeline. He says Diana left oxygen toward cafeteria, then he later finds her dead in cafeteria. That means he was also right around the exact area and timing. And I specifically did not see him in cafeteria when I passed through, so either he came in right after me, or he’s leaving out the important part of his timing.

Alice and Frank, I get why you feel away from it, and I’m not pushing either of you. But between “Eve briefly passed through and admitted seeing Diana alive” versus “Charlie has reported both bodies and was tracking Diana right before she died,” I think Charlie self-report is the more dangerous possibility. I’m voting Charlie.
